parallel_contract.note: Provider routes (GET /api/attribution/records, /records/{record_id}, /shadow/{decision_id}) were not present in services/evaluation at delivery. The BFF is built to the fixed C3 shape with the owner doubled at urllib.request.urlopen; no integration test against the real provider was possible. If the merged provider differs, follow it. Owner base URL env: PANTHEON_EVALUATION_API_URL / PANTHEON_EVALUATION_SERVICE_URL / EVALUATION_URL; token env: EVALUATION_SERVICE_TOKEN / EVALUATION_API_TOKEN (names chosen here, confirm with provider).

changes.services/control-plane/bff/attribution/c: AttributionOwnerClient (GET only, service token, management read budget) plus shaping: record list/detail with decomposition, luck interval, MT-4 meeting link and hypothesis validation status; shadow comparison merging four arms (trader, base_strategy, private_servant, institutional_view) from the Agora decision lock with settlement source from the attribution owner; explicit unavailable envelope. No attribution number is computed.
changes.services/control-plane/bff/attribution/r: GET /bff/management/attribution/records, /outliers, /records/{record_id}, /shadow/{decision_id}; operators see all identities, a trader only own records/decisions; unknown or not-owned id is 404; filter validation 422; meeting enrichment from consultation is best effort.
changes.services/control-plane/bff/core/app_fact: mounts the attribution router with an Agora decision-lock reader from the agora_owner dependency
